accepted_iterate_instrumentation.admission: audit pinned solver driver source and adapter event semantics before scientific execution; callbacks alone are not proof; unavailable acceptance evidence is BLOCKED_INSTRUMENTATION
accepted_iterate_instrumentation.callback_role: observation hook only; reject trial evaluations and duplicate event tokens; no manufactured or terminal-only callback entries
accepted_iterate_instrumentation.diagnostic_accounting: all external iterate checks consume diagnostic F/G/model allowances as requested; cache reuse logged, no exemption or budget extension
accepted_iterate_instrumentation.duplicate_coordinates: record but do not count exact repeated coordinate vectors as new accepted moves
accepted_iterate_instrumentation.early_termination: INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY if fewer than five qualifying final moves, including zero iterations; preserve solver flag, no padding or restart

events.L-BFGS-B: one source-confirmed NEW_X event after line-search acceptance per solver iteration
events.SLSQP: one source-confirmed completed major-iteration event after its line search; major counter strictly increases

accepted_iterate_instrumentation.history: five consecutive source-confirmed accepted nonzero moves with exact-feasible smooth endpoints and predecessor; six checked states, initial point may be predecessor only
accepted_iterate_instrumentation.invalid_event: break certified history on infeasible/nonsmooth state or Phase B equality violation; retain raw log
record: Phase B equality residual when applicable
accepted_iterate_instrumentation.scope: both Phase A candidates and Phase B; baseline logging never changes original solver settings or historical classification
accepted_iterate_instrumentation.terminal: returned coordinates must equal final source-confirmed state; independently recheck terminal; mismatch or missing evidence is INCONCLUSIVE_INSTRUMENTATION

cohort.per_cell_selection: minimum key among exactly two eligible entities

allowed: 32 assessment observations per lift at days 6,13,...,223
inputs.mount_rule: separate allowlisted read-only inputs; no truth/test/result-output mount; access log required

limitations: known synthetic law and zero initial states
eight of sixteen schedule-plan cells only
prior dependence belongs to original Bayesian study

normalizer_verification.constant_agreement: abs(sum_l 32*log(Zacc_A(sigma_l)/Zacc_B(sigma_l))) <= tau_eval at each checked case/vector
normalizer_verification.diagnostic_assignment: compute once per unique sigma, assigned in listed sigma order to the first four frozen Phase A cases (sentinel list order, noise 1 then 2); charge each integrand request to that case diagnostic bucket before solving; cache immutable results for all cases, no counter borrowing
normalizer_verification.error_scope: reported integration estimates and cross-method agreement, not a rigorous absolute-error proof; no numerical checks performed here
normalizer_verification.failure: FAILED_OBJECTIVE for resolved disagreement; INCONCLUSIVE_NORMALIZER for quadrature warning, unresolved error/precision or budget exhaustion; no refinement beyond fixed settings

procedure_A.algorithm: adaptive 21-point Gauss-Kronrod via scipy.integrate.quad, separately on each smooth z-support piece

procedure_B.algorithm: composite 32-point Gauss-Legendre; independent load-fraction CDF integrand
procedure_B.cdf: Phi(x)=0.5*erfc(-x/sqrt(2)) using math.erfc; no procedure-A density/weight helper
procedure_B.nodes_weights: numpy.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(32), affine map to each equal-width panel

normalizer_verification.valid_range: finite and 0 < Zacc <= 1 for every estimate

objective.ell0: nll minus the q-independent Gaussian and acceptance constants
objective.search_penalty_use: original quadratic guidance only, divided by 96 for candidates

requirements: two original starts per candidate within objective band
no lower feasible unqualified terminal beyond agreement band
phase_a_pass.terminal_checks: all 12 procedure/start terminals plus four starting points when feasible/smooth; failed terminals remain unqualified, not excluded from records

phase_b.anchor: Candidate S best qualified Phase A vector; ties within tau_eval resolved by lexicographic full coordinate vector
phase_b.constraint_jacobian: analytic, independently finite-difference checked with shared probes
phase_b.definition: L_T(t)=inf{ell0(q):q in Q, all weights positive,T(q)=t}; D_T(t)=2*(L_T(t)-inf ell0)
phase_b.entity_rule: first two sentinels by fixed selection hash order

near_optimal_alternative.above_upper_bound_action: REJECT_ALTERNATIVE; retain profile record, no near-optimal evidence
near_optimal_alternative.below_reference_action: INCONCLUSIVE_REFERENCE; invalidate reference and stop, no recentering
near_optimal_alternative.common_reference: same-case qualified Phase A Candidate S anchor; immutable for both vectors
near_optimal_alternative.required_evidence: each of two stored vectors separately passes exact feasibility, smoothness, derivative and applicable stationarity/KKT checks for its own target; same entity/noise/schedules and one common qualified Phase A reference

phase_b_requires: separate explicit owner Phase B authorization

procedures.selection: original converged-first then lowest finite feasible, flagged nonconverged if none; compare lowest feasible separately

reporting: all cases and starts including failures
raw solver status and separate independent qualification
bound modes and multiple modes separately
no population or global uniqueness claims

resources.abort: earliest call/wall/CPU/process-tree memory cap wins; stop process tree, retain partial logs, INCONCLUSIVE_RESOURCE, no replacement or extension
resources.accounting: all requested evaluations, including rejected/penalty/constraint/finite difference/independent checks; fused requests count F and G; target and likelihood perturbation checks share trajectory evaluations

hard_budget_contract.atomic_admission: before any work reserve every affected bucket and enclosing start/case/phase counter; refuse the request if any would exceed its limit
hard_budget_contract.authority: resources object in draft-protocol.json; prose/checklist tables must match it exactly
hard_budget_contract.bucket_rule: solver requests consume own start bucket; external checks including callbacks/terminal/normalizer consume diagnostics; both consume case/phase counters; no transfers, resets or borrowing
hard_budget_contract.ceiling_state: INCONCLUSIVE_RESOURCE; no later qualification from unfinished checks
hard_budget_contract.model_accounting: a fused F/G/model evaluation increments each once; separate model/target/constraint passes increment model counter; pure normalizer quadrature consumes diagnostic F per integrand request, no G/model absent such work; cache hits cause no model pass but requested F/G still count

resources.hard_counter_admission_test: inert non-scientific functions only, later authorized stage

starts.fourth: original stored entity/noise-keyed Python random.Random uniform(0.1,0.9) vector
starts.reuse: same four original starts for every Phase A procedure; no warm starts
